title: Motion Principles
slide_intent: Help designers decide whether movement earns a viewer’s attention. Motion should make the communication easier to follow.
strategic_value: Consistent direction across an interaction and an end card can make Instacart feel purposeful without asking every element to move.
demonstration: A text rail asks whether the piece needs motion. Two lists compare desired qualities in green with undesirable qualities in red, including smooth versus frenetic.
practical_value: Start by deciding whether motion adds anything, then judge the proposed movement against the paired qualities.

content_islands.name: Editorial guidance
content_islands.spec: Stack short paragraphs in the left rail on when to use motion and how it should support the communication.

content_islands.name: Contrasting qualities
content_islands.spec: Pair two aligned word lists, one with a green check and one with a red cross. Keep the four terms in each column easy to scan.
